card.name: Place words after location-linked verbs and prepositions
card.fires_on: The word 'home' after take, and city names that end a conference or event location (Honolulu, Los Angeles, Barcelona, Rio). Also a few words naming a place where something is left or presented.

modes.description: A city name giving where a meeting or conference is held.
modes.example: Proceedings of the twenty-third International Conference on Information Systems,<< Barcelona>>, Spain.

card.writes: The suppressed tokens are Chinese words for living in or entering a place, so it seems to push away from verbs of entering or residing and toward place names and nouns.
card.plain: It marks the place word that ends a phrase, like 'take home' or the city where a conference is held.
